note: One point per valid termination date (reference-year calendar). A date that crosses Feb 29 has a different real gap in leap years (`gap_days_in_leap_years`); each historical season is evaluated with its own real gap. With the fixed 14-day rule the check count is a step: the dry-year count below 14 days, 0 at or above (unless the grower reports a low-moisture concern, which fires every evaluable season below 14 days).
